faq.q: What if the weather is bad on the proposal day?

data.body_html:
Imagine the golden sun dipping behind La Concha mountain, the Mediterranean turning to liquid amber, and you on a private boat with the love of your life. That's the magic of a marbella sunset cruise romantic proposal 2032. With our fleet departing from Puerto Banús, you can plan a moment that's truly unforgettable. From €749 for 2 hours on a luxurious motor yacht, we handle the details so you can focus on the big question.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise for Your Proposal?

Sunset is the most romantic time on the Costa del Sol. The light is soft, the crowds are ashore, and the sea turns to glass. A private cruise gives you complete privacy—no noisy restaurants, no crowded beaches. You can choose your spot: anchor off Cala del Faro or drift near Cala Cortés. The skipper will help you find the perfect moment. Plus, with drinks and snacks included, the mood is set from the moment you step aboard.

Our Fleet for Romantic Proposals

We offer a range of boats to suit your style. For an intimate proposal, our Tier A boats are ideal:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h

For a grand gesture, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 passengers) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats like the Pershing 46 or Ferretti 94 are available on request. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

What's Included in Your Proposal Cruise

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. Spanish VAT (21%) is included. You just bring the ring. Want extra touches? We can arrange roses, a photographer, or a special cake via WhatsApp booking. The skipper will steer you to the best sunset spot and give you privacy when you need it.

Best Time for a Sunset Proposal in 2032

The Mediterranean sunset is spectacular from June to September, when the sun sets around 21:00-21:30. Aim to depart 2 hours before sunset to enjoy the golden hour. In spring and autumn, sunsets are earlier (19:00-20:00) and the sea is calmer. Winter proposals are also possible with earlier sunsets (around 18:00) and cooler temperatures (15-18°C). Our boats have heating and blankets for comfort.

How to Book Your Marbella Sunset Cruise Romantic Proposal 2032

Booking is simple. Visit our homepage to explore the fleet, then contact us via WhatsApp for custom requests. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for summer proposals. Provide your preferred date, boat type, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. Payment is secure, and cancellation is free up to 48 hours before departure.

Tips for a Perfect Proposal

  • Choose a boat that matches your guest count—intimate for two, or larger for a surprise party.
  • Bring the ring in a secure box; the skipper can keep it safe until the moment.
  • Consider a sunset at 21:00 in July; the light is golden and the sea is warm (24°C).
  • Have a backup date in case of weather—we reschedule for free.
  • Hire a photographer to capture the moment; we can recommend one.
